ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is the horizontal distance of the slope surface, indicating the positional change from the upper slope to the lower slope; the curve and shading show that the erosion amount/sediment loss amount is not consistent along different slope sections of the slope surface, and erosion and loss in the middle-lower section of the slope surface are more obvious. Since erosion is relatively strong in the middle-lower slope section, the focus of management should be reducing slope surface runoff scouring and stabilizing soil, and the corresponding measure for ecological restoration is restoring vegetation cover. Therefore, closing hillsides to facilitate afforestation and grass planting should be adopted.

Reasoning: The question stem requires considering the ecological restoration measure for small watershed management on the Loess Plateau from the angle of the “difference in slope surface erosion” shown in the figure. Since erosion is relatively strong in the middle-lower slope section, the focus of management should be reducing slope surface runoff scouring and stabilizing soil, and the corresponding measure for ecological restoration is restoring vegetation cover. Therefore, closing hillsides to facilitate afforestation and grass planting should be adopted.
